interpreted_intent: Create this arm's independently chosen complex photorealistic test scene in the flooded baroque library manuscript rescue lane, using the attached image only to inform the unmistakably adult woman's appearance and keeping her unobscured face and entire hair arrangement readable for later semantic-render evaluation.
subject: one unmistakably adult woman visually informed by the supplied appearance reference
setting: a flooded baroque library with carved shelves, marble reading tables, toppled globes, ladders, and drifting gilded folios
event: she braces against a marble reading table and pulls an illuminated manuscript from a collapsing carved shelf into a raised archival cradle
visual_priorities: an unobscured, recognizable face and the complete readable arrangement of her hair from crown to ends
clear rescue causality between the collapsing shelf, her securing hands, and the manuscript reaching safety
convincingly photorealistic architectural damage, reflected floodwater, and fragile paper textures
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic narrative image of a flooded baroque library manuscript rescue centered on one unmistakably adult woman visually informed by the supplied appearance reference: an oval face, softly arched brows, almond-shaped dark eyes, a delicate straight nose, and naturally full lips. She braces against a marble reading table and pulls an illuminated manuscript from a collapsing carved shelf into a raised archival cradle while ankle-deep water carries loose gilded folios between toppled globes and ladders. Preserve clear rescue causality between the shelf giving way, her hands securing the volume, and the manuscript reaching safety. Give equal visual priority to her unobscured, recognizable face and the complete readable arrangement of her hair from crown to ends, alongside convincingly photorealistic architectural damage, reflected floodwater, and fragile paper textures.
